Gold / Silver: S.S. Aqua first arrival establishes Vermilion as the practical Kanto opening after the first League clear.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: Same opening is retained after the National Dex/S.S. Aqua sequence from Phase 9.
Integration decision: Keep Kanto as an open postgame region rather than replacing it with a rigid HGSS-only linear sequence.

Gold / Silver: Most Kanto Leaders can be challenged in flexible order once their local map/event conditions are satisfied.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: HGSS preserves broad nonlinearity but adds local prerequisites, phone/rematch states and a Kanto-badge counter.
Integration decision: Use independent leader eligibility predicates; do not hard-code a single eight-Gym order.

Gold / Silver: Manager dialogue starts the stolen Machine Part state; flags expose the Cerulean Gym Rocket and prepare the guard phone-call scene.
Crystal: Crystal uses the same core state machine and adds its own NPC/trade content.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: Power Plant `R10R0202` sets `FLAG_GOT_POWER_PLANT_MANAGERS_STORY`, updates the Power Plant scene, then exposes the Cerulean Rocket.
Integration decision: Preserve the GSC event identity; HGSS choreography/state names are implementation references, not a replacement story.

Gold / Silver: After Power Plant activation, the Rocket Grunt runs out of the Cerulean Gym and relocates toward Route 24.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: `T04GYM0101` hides the Gym Rocket, clears the Route 24 Rocket hide flag and advances Route 24 state.
Integration decision: Use one semantic `MACHINE_PART_ROCKET_DISCOVERED`; retain source-specific movement and map-scene choreography.

Gold / Silver: The foreign Rocket member is encountered north of Cerulean and defeated as part of the theft investigation.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: `R24` contains the remake battle/state progression before the Machine Part can be reclaimed.
Integration decision: Preserve this as a mandatory substate of the Power Plant case, not an optional trainer.

Gold / Silver: Cerulean Gym is initially disrupted and Misty is away on Route 25; resolving the Rocket encounter returns the Gym toward normal operation.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: HGSS explicitly clears Misty and boyfriend hide flags when the Rocket escapes the Gym and uses Route 25 scene states.
Integration decision: Model Misty availability separately from badge possession; avoid spawning two Misty actors.

Gold / Silver: Misty is met outside the Gym before returning to accept the challenge.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: `R25` handles Misty scene state and additionally participates in the HGSS Suicune chain.
Integration decision: Keep Misty-return state independent from Suicune/Eusine states so Crystal integration cannot deadlock the Gym.

Gold / Silver: The missing Machine Part is found in Cerulean Gym after the Rocket clue/battle state.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: `T04GYM0101` gives `ITEM_MACHINE_PART`, hides the pickup markers and advances the Route 24 state.
Integration decision: Preserve the Gym recovery location and use an explicit key-item possession + claimed flag pair.

Gold / Silver: Returning MACHINE_PART consumes the item and sets the permanent Kanto-power-restored state.
Crystal: Same; Crystal retains extra NPC content in the facility.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: HGSS warps to the repaired Power Plant map variant and sets `FLAG_RESTORED_POWER`.
Integration decision: Use a permanent `KANTO_POWER_RESTORED`; map visual state should be derived from it after reload.

Gold / Silver: Manager rewards TM07 Zap Cannon after the repair.
Crystal: Same core reward in Crystal source.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: Manager rewards TM57 Charge Beam after repair.
Integration decision: Never overwrite one reward with the other. Preserve GSC TM07 under GSC mode and expose HGSS TM57 as an additive/remake reward after TM-table expansion.

Gold / Silver: After restoring power, the Kanto radio upgrade can be obtained.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: `T05R0701` requires `FLAG_RESTORED_POWER`, then sets `FLAG_GOT_EXPN_CARD` and registers the Pokégear card if needed.
Integration decision: Make restored power the authoritative prerequisite; preserve one-time acquisition and repeat dialogue.

Gold / Silver: The Kanto radio expansion enables the Poké Flute channel used for Snorlax.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: HGSS checks whether radio music channel 5 is currently playing at the Snorlax object.
Integration decision: Implement the actual channel/playback predicate, not a simple key-item check.

Gold / Silver: Vermilion-side Snorlax is Lv.50; Pokégear near Snorlax + Poké Flute channel wakes it and sets `EVENT_FOUGHT_SNORLAX`.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: Route 11 script uses `RadioMusicIsPlaying 5`, then a Lv.50 static battle and separate meet/caught flags.
Integration decision: Preserve Lv.50 and road-opening role; keep battle-attempt, defeated/met and caught outcomes distinct.

Gold / Silver: GSC battle removes the roadblock after the encounter result and records the event.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: HGSS has explicit `FLAG_ENGAGING_STATIC_POKEMON`, loss branch, `FLAG_SNORLAX_MEET` and `FLAG_CAUGHT_SNORLAX`.
Integration decision: Adopt HGSS-grade outcome tracking while preserving GSC map progression semantics.

Gold / Silver: Removing Snorlax gives practical access through Diglett Cave to Route 2/Pewter side.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: HGSS rebuilds the same regional connector with DS maps and field systems.
Integration decision: Do not replace Diglett Cave with a warp shortcut; preserve encounters, exits and side objects.

Gold / Silver: After Machine Part return, Copycat discusses her lost Poké Doll and the Vermilion Fan Club branch becomes relevant.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: HGSS power restoration changes Copycat/Fan Club visibility and later awards `ITEM_PASS`.
Integration decision: Keep as a post-repair side arc; it must not gate ordinary Kanto Gym progression.

Gold / Silver: Vermilion Fan Club gives `LOST_ITEM` only after Copycat has asked for it.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: HGSS likewise exposes the Fan Club lost item after repair and Copycat-state progression.
Integration decision: Use explicit requested/obtained/returned states to prevent early duplication.

Gold / Silver: Returning LOST_ITEM to Copycat gives PASS for the Magnet Train.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: `T11R0802` consumes `ITEM_LOST_ITEM`, shows the returned doll and gives `ITEM_PASS`.
Integration decision: Preserve the GSC quest verbatim in logic; upgrade only presentation and item UI.

Gold / Silver: Restored Kanto power and possession of PASS make the Saffron–Goldenrod rail service usable.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: HGSS retains the service with Gen IV field/UI presentation.
Integration decision: Treat power restoration and ticket entitlement as separate prerequisites.

Gold / Silver: Vermilion Gym awards Thunder Badge; Gen II script does not give a Leader TM here and notes the old traps are inactive.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: HGSS reactivates a trash-can switch puzzle, awards Thunder Badge + TM34 and increments the Kanto badge counter.
Integration decision: Preserve Gen II no-TM reward under GSC mode; add HGSS TM34 as source-specific reward. Preserve both puzzle variants as selectable compatibility behavior.

Gold / Silver: Cerulean Gym becomes challengeable after Misty returns; badge is the persistent progression reward.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: HGSS awards Cascade Badge + TM03 and increments the Kanto badge counter.
Integration decision: Keep theft/Misty-return prerequisites separate from battle completion and TM receipt.

Gold / Silver: Pewter Gym awards Boulder Badge; Gen II script has no Leader TM reward.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: HGSS awards Boulder Badge + TM80; TM receipt has its own retry flag.
Integration decision: Preserve GSC reward state and add HGSS TM80 only in remake/integrated reward layer.

Gold / Silver: Celadon Gym awards Rainbow Badge under Gen II rules.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: HGSS awards Rainbow Badge + TM19, increments Kanto badge counter and adds leader-phone/rematch availability logic.
Integration decision: Retain source-specific trainer/TM data; phone/rematch must not make the Leader disappear during first challenge.

Gold / Silver: Fuchsia Gym uses Janine plus disguised trainers and awards Soul Badge.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: HGSS expands the disguise reveal logic, awards Soul Badge + TM84 and adds rematch schedule state.
Integration decision: Preserve disguise puzzle identity and expand object-state tracking rather than simplifying the Gym.

Gold / Silver: Saffron Gym retains teleport-pad identity and awards Marsh Badge.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: HGSS awards Marsh Badge + TM48 and has post-badge/rematch schedule logic.
Integration decision: Preserve teleport topology; keep first battle, TM retry and rematch states independent.

Gold / Silver: Cinnabar Gym is gone after the eruption; Blaine operates from Seafoam Islands.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: HGSS reconstructs a larger Seafoam Gym with trainers, awards Volcano Badge + TM50.
Integration decision: Preserve the destroyed-Cinnabar premise while using expandable Seafoam map data; do not restore the old RBY Gym as the main Gen II-era location.

Gold / Silver: Talking to Blue on Cinnabar immediately sends him back to Viridian Gym; no Kanto-badge-count check is performed.
Crystal: Same source-family behavior unless a Crystal-specific difference is proven later.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: Different: HGSS checks Kanto badge counter and refuses progression below 7.
Integration decision: Provide explicit `GSC_ORDERING` and `HGSS_ORDERING`; never mislabel the 7-badge requirement as a GSC rule.

Event / System: Blue on Cinnabar — HGSS seven-badge gate
Gold / Silver: Absent as a count gate.
Crystal: Absent in the Gen II source family.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: `T09` compares `VAR_UNK_4135` against 7; at 7+ Blue leaves for Viridian and updates hide/scene flags.
Integration decision: In HGSS mode require seven Kanto badges before Blue returns; in GSC mode conversation alone is sufficient.

Gold / Silver: Viridian Gym awards Earth Badge and marks the final Kanto Leader victory.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: HGSS awards Earth Badge + TM92, increments the badge counter, and advances Oak/postgame variables.
Integration decision: Preserve Earth Badge as semantic completion fact; keep source-specific TM and aftermath.

Gold / Silver: Gen II can derive completion directly from badge bitfield/`VAR_BADGES`; no equivalent dedicated remake counter is required.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: Every Kanto Leader script increments `VAR_UNK_4135`; Blue checks 7 and the upgraded League checks 8.
Integration decision: Target should maintain a semantic Kanto-badge count derived from badge bits or a validated counter, with consistency checks on load.

Gold / Silver: Gen II Leader rewards generally follow their own source scripts; no generic remake-style retry framework applies to all Kanto Leaders.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: HGSS stores separate flags such as `FLAG_GOT_TM80_FROM_BROCK`, allowing later collection if the Bag was full.
Integration decision: Backport the robust retry pattern for any one-time reward without changing which source reward is owed.

Gold / Silver: No HGSS-style Gym Leader phone rematch framework.
Crystal: Crystal phone system exists, but not the full HGSS Leader-rematch architecture.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: HGSS Leaders have contact registration, weekday/time availability, temporary absence from Gyms and Fighting Dojo rematch records.
Integration decision: Add as an HGSS system layer after phone/save expansion; first-story challenge eligibility must remain independent.

Gold / Silver: Absent as the HGSS Leader-rematch hub.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: Registered Leaders can appear at Saffron Fighting Dojo for stronger rematch teams.
Integration decision: Backport as optional postgame content; do not replace ordinary Gym rematches/first battles.

Gold / Silver: GSC keeps its Gen II League data unless another source-specific rematch rule applies.
Crystal: Crystal preserves its own League data.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: Will/Koga/Bruno/Karen/Lance scripts compare `VAR_UNK_4135` to 8; at 8 they select `_2` upgraded trainer records.
Integration decision: Unlock HGSS upgraded League when all eight Kanto badges are held; preserve original first-League records as a separate tier.

Gold / Silver: Oak reads total badge state; at all 16 badges he sets `EVENT_OPENED_MT_SILVER`.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: Different implementation chain after Earth Badge leads to Oak and Mt. Silver unlock.
Integration decision: Preserve the GSC direct 16-badge rule as authoritative in GSC mode.

Gold / Silver: No Rock Climb HM08 reward exists in Gen II.
Crystal: No Gen II Rock Climb system.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: Oak Lab checks the post-Earth-Badge state, gives HM08, sets `VAR_UNK_4110=2`, `FLAG_UNLOCKED_MT_SILVER`, then `FLAG_GOT_HM08`.
Integration decision: Separate `MT_SILVER_ACCESS_GRANTED` from `ROCK_CLIMB_OBTAINED`; do not make GSC mode depend on a field move that did not exist there.

Gold / Silver: After Oak opens Mt. Silver, the western branch of the League gate becomes accessible.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: HGSS uses dedicated `FLAG_UNLOCKED_MT_SILVER`/west-Kanto gate state in the shared Reception Gate.
Integration decision: Use one semantic gate entitlement and source-specific NPC/object flags.

Gold / Silver: Mt. Silver is a full high-level postgame area, not only the Red room.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: HGSS greatly expands cave topology and adds Gen IV field systems/content.
Integration decision: Port the entire area floor-by-floor; never compress the project to a direct Red warp.

Gold / Silver: Not a Gen II Mt. Silver static legendary event.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: HGSS adds a Lv.50 Moltres static encounter in Mt. Silver Cave.
Integration decision: Add as HGSS-only optional content with its own encounter/caught flags.

Gold / Silver: Not present as a GSC static Kanto bird encounter.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: HGSS adds Lv.50 Articuno in Seafoam Islands.
Integration decision: Backport as HGSS optional legendary content; do not rewrite Gen II historical source data.

Gold / Silver: Not present as a GSC static Kanto bird encounter.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: HGSS adds Lv.50 Zapdos near the restored Power Plant; Blue defeat clears its hide flag in the checked script chain.
Integration decision: Keep encounter availability independent from the Machine Part reward and record exact unlock predicate.

Gold / Silver: Cerulean Cave/Mewtwo are not part of the GSC Kanto content set.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: HGSS restores Cerulean Cave and a Lv.70 Mewtwo static encounter with caught-state tracking.
Integration decision: Treat cave restoration and Mewtwo as HGSS additions that coexist with all GSC Kanto content.

Gold / Silver: Absent.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: Vermilion script checks game version: HeartGold branch announces/creates Latias roamer; SoulSilver branch announces/creates Latios roamer.
Integration decision: Keep one shared script/state machine with version-dependent species; never duplicate the event merely because ROM script bytes match.

Gold / Silver: Gold/Silver do not contain the Crystal-style Eusine/Suicune pursuit system.
Crystal: Crystal has its own Suicune story culminating at Tin/Bell Tower.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: HGSS Vermilion contains Suicune + Eusine movement, then clears the next Route 14 Suicune state.
Integration decision: For Crystal target, if Suicune was already captured, convert Kanto chase into Eusine epilogue; otherwise allow the HGSS pursuit branch. Never undo Crystal capture canon.

Gold / Silver: Absent in G/S.
Crystal: Crystal source uses a different Johto-centered Suicune progression.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: Cerulean Gym/Route 25 scripts participate in the HGSS Kanto Suicune sequence.
Integration decision: Keep `CRYSTAL_SUICUNE_CAPTURED` and `HGSS_SUICUNE_CHASE_STAGE` independent.

Gold / Silver: Red waits at the summit/end of Mt. Silver as the final postgame superboss.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: HGSS retains Red on Mt. Silver with a remade summit map.
Integration decision: Preserve location, silence motif, and optional superboss status.

Gold / Silver: Lv81 Pikachu, Lv73 Espeon, Lv75 Snorlax, Lv77 Venusaur, Lv77 Charizard, Lv77 Blastoise.
Crystal: Crystal source family preserves the Gen II Red concept/data family.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: HGSS replaces Espeon with Lapras and raises the team dramatically.
Integration decision: Keep a selectable/verifiable GSC Red record; do not silently overwrite with HGSS data.

Gold / Silver: Not applicable.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: Lv88 Pikachu (Light Ball), Lv80 Lapras, Lv82 Snorlax, Lv84 Venusaur, Lv84 Charizard, Lv84 Blastoise with authored Gen IV moves/items/abilities.
Integration decision: Store as a separate HGSS battle tier using the Gen IV battle engine features.

Gold / Silver: After victory, Red disappears, party is healed and credits run.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: HGSS hides Red, sets completion variables, grants Legend Ribbon to every party Pokémon and invokes credits.
Integration decision: Preserve GSC ending flow; add HGSS ribbon/start-Pokémon rewards as explicit remake additions.

Gold / Silver: No equivalent Red-win Kanto starter-ball unlock in Gen II.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: On first qualifying Red win, HGSS clears Oak Lab Bulbasaur/Charmander/Squirtle ball hide flags.
Integration decision: Backport only after species-choice UI/event storage is available; label as HGSS addition.

Gold / Silver: No Legend Ribbon system.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: HGSS loops over the party and gives `RIBBON_LEGEND` after Red victory.
Integration decision: Requires ribbon/save-structure expansion; never emulate with an unrelated flag.

Gold / Silver: Normal battle loss/whiteout handling applies.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: HGSS Red script explicitly calls WhiteOut on loss.
Integration decision: Regression-test loss without setting completion/ribbon/starter-unlock states.

Gold / Silver: Not applicable.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: All 23 Phase 10 Korean HG/SS field-script members checked directly are byte-identical even where runtime version branches exist.
Integration decision: Treat byte equality as shared implementation evidence only, not evidence of identical version behavior/content.

Gold / Silver: Legacy event flags/badge bits must survive save/load.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: HGSS adds many hide flags, scene vars, badge counter, caught flags, phone contacts and one-time reward flags.
Integration decision: Create a Kanto state audit that reconstructs derived counters from authoritative badge bits and validates mutually exclusive actor flags after load.

Gold / Silver: Kanto is complete only when legacy maps/events and Red progression still function.
Crystal: Crystal-specific side content must also remain available.
HeartGold / SoulSilver: HGSS additions include expanded Gyms, rematches, restored legends, Kanto roamers, Suicune chase and Red aftermath.
Integration decision: Do not mark Phase 10 implementation complete until story, optional content, save/reload, whiteout, transport and version branches pass regression tests.
